steps.title: Labor Portal Registration

items.title: Labor Portal (E-Sosial)
items.text: Azerbaijan has fully digitized its labor relations. No paper contract is valid until the employer registers it on the government e-portal. This prevents backdated terminations or hiring.

items.title: 13th Month Salary
items.text: While not legally mandatory, a 13th-month bonus is a common market practice during the Novruz holiday or New Year, especially in the private sector.

items.title: Probation Periods
items.text: The statutory maximum for probation is 3 months. During this period, termination can often be executed with 3 days' notice if the contract permits.

items.title: Notice Periods
items.text: Statutory notice periods depend on length of service, ranging from 2 weeks for short tenures to 2 months for long-term employees.

faqs.question: Can I hire expats through an EOR in Azerbaijan?
faqs.answer: Yes, but they require a work permit. The EOR partner acts as the visa sponsor and handles the application with the State Migration Service.

faqs.question: Are there specific notice periods for retirement?
faqs.answer: The Labor Code does not specify a different notice period for retirement, but mutual agreements are common for smooth transitions in high-level roles.

faqs.question: How is the 13th month bonus taxed?
faqs.answer: It is treated as a component of the annual salary and is subject to standard income tax (where applicable) and social insurance contributions.

faqs.question: What happens if a contract is not registered on e-sosial?
faqs.answer: The contract is legally void, and the employer can face significant fines. The employee also loses access to the state insurance system.

faqs.question: What is the maximum overtime allowed?
faqs.answer: Under the Labor Code, overtime should not exceed 4 hours over two consecutive workdays or 124 hours over a year.

faqs.question: Are there specific notice periods for pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Expectant mothers are protected from dismissal under the Labor Code. They are entitled to paid maternity leave (126 days standard).

faqs.question: Can an EOR handle car allowances for sales teams?
faqs.answer: Yes, EOR partners can manage taxable car allowances or mileage reimbursements according to local tax thresholds.

items.title: Income Tax Holiday
items.text: Employees in the non-oil/gas private sector benefit from a 0% personal income tax rate on salaries up to 8,000 AZN. This incentive is currently slated until 2026.

items.title: Wage Payment Deadlines
items.text: Salaries must be paid at least twice a month. Delaying beyond the 15-day interval between payments can trigger penalties from the State Labor Inspection Service.

items.title: Mandatory Bank Transfers
items.text: Cash payments for salaries are prohibited for companies above a minimal turnover. All wages must be paid via non-cash bank transfers to employee cards.

faqs.question: What is the official currency for payroll?
faqs.answer: All payroll must be calculated and paid in Azerbaijani Manat (AZN). Contracts can mention foreign currency values, but the payout must be in local currency.

faqs.question: How is sick leave paid?
faqs.answer: The first 14 calendar days are paid by the employer. After 14 days, the State Social Protection Fund (SSPF) takes over the payment.

faqs.question: Are bonuses taxable?
faqs.answer: Yes, bonuses and performance incentives are generally treated as salary and are subject to the same income tax and social insurance rules.

faqs.question: Is it possible to pay in crypto?
faqs.answer: No, crypto-payments for salaries are not legally recognized in Azerbaijan. All statutory payments must be in AZN through regulated banks.

items.title: Annual Income Tax Return

items.title: Labor Contract Registry Check
items.description: Ensure all new hires/terminations are updated on the Ministry portal.

items.title: Mandatory Health (ITS)
items.text: The ITS rate is 2% for both employer and employee on the portion of salary below 8,000 AZN, and 0.5% on the portion above.

items.title: Minimum Wage
items.text: Calculations must never fall below the National Minimum Wage (345 AZN as of 2024, subject to 2025 updates).

items.title: Rounding Rules
items.text: Tax calculations in Azerbaijan are typically rounded to the nearest gopik (0.01 AZN).

items.title: Holiday Pay Impacts
items.text: Manual calculations for vacation pay depend on the average daily earnings of the previous 12 months.

faqs.question: Does the calculator include work permit costs?
faqs.answer: No, this tool focuses on recurring salary costs. One-time setup fees like work permits must be budgeted separately.

faqs.question: Can I calculate net of lunch allowances?
faqs.answer: The core calculator handles statutory pay. Fixed allowances are usually added as tax-neutral or taxed separately depending on their classification.

faqs.question: How accurate is the non-oil exemption?
faqs.answer: The calculator follows the Tax Code amendment active until 2026, which provides the 0% rate for private non-oil sector employees.

faqs.question: Is the unemployment insurance capped?
faqs.answer: Unemployment insurance is 0.5% for both parties and is generally not capped, unlike the SSPF which has tiered triggers.

faqs.question: Does it support civil law contracts?
faqs.answer: Our calculator is designed for standard labor contracts. Civil law (VÖEN) contracts have different tax logic entirely.

heroData.subtitle: Set up your MMC in Baku efficiently
heroData.description: Establish your business in a strategic corridor between Europe and Asia. Azerbaijan offers 100% foreign ownership, no minimum capital requirements, and a streamlined digital registration process through the ASAN Service centers.
heroData.bestFor: Large-scale investors and software companies targeting Technopark incentives

steps.title: Name Reservation
steps.description: Check and reserve a unique company name with the State Tax Service. The name must be in Azerbaijani but can include a translation.

steps.title: Document Legalization
steps.description: For foreign founders, parent company documents or personal passports must be notarized and Apostilled/Legalized.

steps.title: ASAN Center Submission
steps.description: Submit registration forms, Charter, and Founder's Resolution at an ASAN Service center or via the 'e-taxes' portal using ASAN Imza.

steps.title: Tax ID & Seal
steps.description: Obtain your VOEN (Tax ID) and order the official company seal. Even in the digital age, the physical seal is still required for many bank operations.

steps.title: Bank Account Opening
steps.description: Open a local corporate bank account. This requires the presence of the director or a power of attorney and take 1-2 days.

rows.label: Minimum Share Capital
values: Legally no minimum, typically 100 AZN is set

items.title: 100% Foreign Ownership
items.text: Unlike some neighboring jurisdictions, Azerbaijan allows foreigners to own 100% of an LLC without a local partner.

items.title: Virtual Office Validity
items.text: While virtual offices are used, authorities may conduct periodic checks. It is recommended to have a clear lease agreement for a physical address (Yuridik ünvan).

items.title: ASAN Imza
items.text: Obtaining an ASAN Imza (Mobile Electronic Signature) is non-negotiable for efficient business. It allows the director to sign tax reports and contracts from anywhere.

faqs.question: How long does it take to register a company?
faqs.answer: Digital registration can be done in 1-2 business days. Physical submission via ASAN usually takes 3-5 business days.

faqs.question: Can I be the director of my own company?
faqs.answer: Yes, but if you are a foreigner, you will need a work permit for the directorship role, or you can appoint a local director temporarily.

faqs.question: Is a secretary required?
faqs.answer: No, Azerbaijani law does not require a company secretary for an LLC (MMC).

faqs.question: Can I open a bank account remotely?
faqs.answer: It is difficult. Most banks require the director to visit in person for KYB checks, though some offer PoA-based setup for established international brands.

faqs.question: What is the timeline for VAT registration?
faqs.answer: VAT registration can be processed within 1-3 business days after the threshold is met or voluntarily requested.

faqs.question: How do recruitment fees work?

faqs.question: Are electronic signatures legally binding for HR?
faqs.answer: Yes, ASAN Imza is the gold standard for electronic signatures in Azerbaijan and is required for most government portal interactions.

faqs.question: Does Azerbaijan require local data hosting?
faqs.answer: While not as strict as some neighbors, it is highly recommended to store the personal data of Azerbaijani citizens on servers located within the country or in 'adequate' jurisdictions.

faqs.question: Can I automate the 13th-month bonus?

faqs.question: What is the fiscal year in Azerbaijan?
faqs.answer: The fiscal year follows the calendar year, from January 1st to December 31st.

faqs.question: Is cloud accounting software allowed?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided it can generate the mandatory reports in the format required by the State Tax Service and respects data privacy laws.

faqs.question: Are simplified tax entities exempt from IFRS?
faqs.answer: Generally, small enterprises and simplified tax payers follow simpler national standards rather than the full IFRS framework.

items.title: AML/KYC Requirements
items.text: Azerbaijan has strict anti-money laundering regulations. Companies must verify the Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO) for all corporate transactions.

items.title: Data Privacy (Law on Personal Data)
items.text: The 2010 Law on Personal Data requires all databases containing personal info of citizens to be registered with the relevant state authority.

items.title: Environmental Compliance
items.text: Energy and industrial projects are subject to rigorous Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) by the Ministry of Ecology.

items.title: Workplace Safety
items.text: Mandatory OHS audits are required for industrial sectors. Employers must provide protective equipment and conduct safety training sessions.

faqs.question: Is there a central registry of UBOs?
faqs.answer: While not fully public, the State Tax Service maintains internal records and requires UBO disclosure during registration and updates.

faqs.question: What are the penalties for data privacy breaches?
faqs.answer: Fines can range from 300 to 5,000 AZN for administrative breaches, but criminal liability can apply for serious intentional leaks.

faqs.question: What is the role of the State Labor Inspection?
faqs.answer: They conduct both planned and unplanned audits to ensure adherence to the Labor Code and workplace safety standards.

faqs.question: Are ISO certifications mandatory in Azerbaijan?
faqs.answer: Not for all businesses, but they are often a prerequisite for participating in state tenders and working with large energy companies like SOCAR.

faqs.question: Can I claim VAT back on business expenses?
faqs.answer: Yes, but only if the expenses are directly linked to your business activity and the vendor has issued a valid e-tax invoice.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for late filing?
faqs.answer: Standard penalties start at 40 AZN but can escalate to percentages of the unpaid tax amount plus interest (0.1% per day).

faqs.question: Is there a wealth tax in Azerbaijan?
faqs.answer: No, there is currently no specific wealth tax for individuals, though property and land taxes apply.

faqs.question: How are dividends taxed for non-residents?
faqs.answer: Dividends paid to non-residents are subject to a 10% withholding tax, which may be reduced under a Double Tax Treaty.

faqs.question: Are there export incentives for software?

faqs.answer: IDDA manages the tech ecosystem, provides grants for startups, and oversees the registration process for various digital incentives.

faqs.question: Are there R&D tax credits?
faqs.answer: While not a traditional tax credit, the massive tax holidays for Technopark residents serve a similar purpose of incentivizing investment in tech development.

items.title: Social Media Landscape
items.text: Instagram and TikTok are the dominant platforms for B2C marketing in Azerbaijan, while LinkedIn is essential for B2B engagement.

items.title: Advertising Law
items.text: All public advertisements must be in the Azerbaijani language. Foreign languages are allowed only as a supplement and must be smaller than the native text.

items.title: Influencer Marketing
items.text: Baku has a vibrant influencer community. Micro-influencers often provide better ROI for niche consumer products than traditional celebrities.

items.title: The 'Baku Style'
items.text: Visual aesthetics in Azerbaijan lean towards premium, high-contrast, and vibrant designs that reflect the city's modern architecture.

faqs.question: Is outdoor advertising expensive in Baku?
faqs.answer: Premium LED screens on main boulevards can be costly, but traditional static billboards offer competitive rates for long-term campaigns.

faqs.question: Do I need a local agency?
faqs.answer: While global strategies work, a local agency is crucial for navigating linguistic nuances and managing relationships with local media outlets.

faqs.question: What is the primary search engine used?
faqs.answer: Google is the primary search engine in Azerbaijan, though Yandex still holds significant market share for certain demographics.

faqs.question: Are there restrictions on alcoholic beverage ads?
faqs.answer: Yes, advertising of tobacco and strong alcoholic beverages is highly restricted in public spaces and mass media.
